methodology: The original research topic and the generated technical specification were decomposed into atomic units by identifying individual requirements, features, behaviors, and constraints. Each atomic unit is designed to be independent, self-contained, technically specific, unambiguous, and implementable as a single requirement. This ensures a granular comparison between the two information sources.
mindtraced_atomic_units: Lemmings can be modeled using a finite state machine.
Lemmings can be in walk_left state (walk_left = 1).
Lemmings can be in walk_right state (walk_right = 1).
Lemmings switch direction if bumped on the left (bump_left = 1).
Lemmings switch direction if bumped on the right (bump_right = 1).
Lemmings switch direction if bumped on both sides.
When ground = 0, Lemmings fall (aaah = 1).
When ground = 1 after falling, Lemmings resume walking in the same direction.
Bumping while falling does not affect walking direction.
Being bumped in the same cycle as ground disappears does not affect walking direction.
When dig = 1 and ground = 1 and not falling, Lemmings start digging (digging = 1).
Lemmings continue digging until ground = 0.
When ground = 0 after digging, Lemmings fall (aaah = 1).
Being bumped while digging has no effect.
dig input is ignored when falling or when there is no ground.
Falling has higher precedence than digging.
Digging has higher precedence than switching directions.
areset is positive edge triggered asynchronous reset.
areset resets the Lemming machine to walk left.
walk_left and walk_right indicate the direction of movement.
bump inputs are ignored when the Lemming is falling or digging.
When the ground disappears (ground=0), the Lemming starts falling (aaah=1).
When the 'dig' input is 1 and the Lemming is walking on the ground (ground=1 and not falling), the Lemming starts digging (digging=1).
spec_atomic_units: outputs walk_left, walk_right, aaah, and digging are derived from inputs bump_left, bump_right, ground, and dig, and the current state.
Precedence of actions is fall > dig > switch directions.
aaah is asserted (1) when the Lemming is falling (ground = 0).
digging is asserted (1) when the Lemming is digging.
Lemming digs only when ground = 1 and dig = 1 and it is not falling.
If bump_left or bump_right is asserted, the Lemming switches direction.
If ground = 0 (falling) or digging = 1, the walking direction remains unchanged.
The `areset` input asynchronously resets the state machine to the walking left state on the positive edge.
The `clk` input clocks the sequential logic.
The outputs `walk_left`, `walk_right`, `aaah`, and `digging` reflect the current state of the Lemming and are updated on the rising edge of `clk`.
The next state logic depends on the current state and the inputs `bump_left`, `bump_right`, `ground`, and `dig`.
